_comment: Who may run Active Time Tracker. Edit this file and commit - changes take effect on each user's next start, no reinstall needed. Entries are Windows accounts, either DOMAIN\username or a bare username. Add a domain to 'domains' to allow everyone in it. Set mode to 'off' to disable the check.
message: Active Time Tracker is not enabled for your account yet. Please contact Samir Tak to request access.
